name: std::jthread::get_stop_source
intro: Returns a std::stop_source associated with the same shared stop-state as held internally by the jthread object.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A value of type std::stop_source associated with stop-state held internally by jthread object.

examples.output:
stop_source: stop_possible = true, stop_requested = false
 
Pass source to other thread:
  Sleepy worker goes back to sleep
Request stop for worker via source
  Sleepy worker is requested to stop
 
stop_source: stop_possible = true, stop_requested = true

summary: Returns a std::stop_source associated with the same shared stop-state as held internally by the jthread object.
